ai_summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers Limited (ABD) has commenced commercial operations at its new 6 million cases per annum bottling facility in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, following a ~₹110 crore acquisition and upgrade. This strategic move strengthens ABD's manufacturing footprint and backward integration strategy, expected to enhance service efficiency and deliver significant cost benefits through increased in-house bottling and reduced franchise fees. No immediate red flags are present, as this aligns with the company's broader investment of over ₹600 crore in the key Uttar Pradesh market.
